prompt: Implement the attached organization-wide Docker base image management brief; support Debian 11 bullseye, Debian 12 bookworm, Debian 13 trixie, Ubuntu 20.04 through 26.04 major LTS releases, opinionated framework images, GitHub Actions publishing, the latest four Alpine and BusyBox versions, a dropdown image selector, and automatic date/time tags.
response: Added Debian, Ubuntu, React, Vite, Alpine 3.21-3.24, and BusyBox 1.36.0-1.38.0 catalog entries plus Dockerfiles, lifecycle metadata, support-matrix entries, and GHCR publication workflow. The publication workflow now offers all 21 image.yaml paths as a dropdown and generates UTC immutable tags as version-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS. BusyBox 1.38.0 is experimental because upstream identifies it as unstable. Normalized all image metadata and replaced rg-only validation with portable grep checks. Verified upstream digests remain release gates.
